explanation: Combined result of the bundle-reader adoption, the study-selection module and the HypoMap atlas client. Bundle reader: queryIndexCorpus.test.ts drives the query index's corpus read over a temp corpus with missing, malformed, wrong-shape, wrong-global and unregistered bundles; bundleReader.test.ts covers listDiskCorpus and jsonpHeader; seoPages.test.ts pins every study-page track label to readDatasetFromDisk; the private parseExpressionBundle test is removed with the parser; deployGuards fixtures use locator globals, and the reduced-release macaque check covers every track_<id>.js in the folder as well as the declared tracks. Study selection: studySelection.test.tsx tests the module at its interface, parameterized by report kind, importing the value and URL form from studySelectionLink.ts; lazyChunkBoundaries.test.ts fails if either evidence ledger is reachable from the entry graph; geneStudyScope.test.ts and the useCategoryScope tests are removed. HypoMap: hypomapAtlasClient.test.ts tests the atlas client through its in-memory transport and absorbs hypomapMetrics.test.ts, which is removed; hypomapFixture.ts builds the fixture export the preview, co-expression and csvDialog tests read.
